Frontend: image generator inside PostModal returns a valid data:image/jpeg;base64 URL (1.18MB) and auto-populates media_url; ConnectorsModal renders all 5 platform rows, YT/IG/FB OAuth Connect triggers setup_required with correct error copy ('youtube OAuth not yet configured. critical_code_review_comments: server.py:2882-2951 — Gemini image gen endpoint correctly returns inline data: URL (mime/base64) since S3 public-read is disabled. Counter-increments captions usage on non-CEO. Solid.

server.py:2763-2805 — OAuth start endpoint correctly returns setup_required JSON (200, not error) when env vars are missing, lists exact missing var names, and includes the redirect_uri so an admin can configure their OAuth app. Studio_only gate enforced before env check — good order.

server.py:2808-2881 — OAuth callback validates state, deletes one-time state, exchanges code, fetches profile, persists access_token + refresh_token. Redirects to /profile with success/error param. NOTE: callback writes access_token/refresh_token to mongo in plaintext — for production consider field-level encryption.

ConnectorsModal.jsx — clean component, proper loading state, surfaces ?connector_connected/?connector_error from URL after OAuth redirect, falls back to manual entry on setup_required with helpful message. Good UX.
ContentStudio.jsx — image generator block lives inside PostModal scoped to the post being scheduled; aspect pills + data: URL auto-populate media_url. Clean integration.
Connectors access_token / refresh_token are correctly excluded from GET /api/connectors response via mongo projection {access_token:0, refresh_token:0}. Good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the two NEW surfaces — image generation end-to-end with live Gemini call, ConnectorsModal OAuth setup_required + manual save/disconnect lifecycle for both OAuth and non-OAuth platforms, Profile page entrypoint. Regression routes all clean.
